cardOverview.overviewText: An invite-only ultra-premium First Private card offering luxury travel perks, concierge services, milestone benefits, and personalized experiences.

items.child: Get upto Rs 750 Discount on Movie Tickets

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: Get upto Rs 750 Discount on Movie Tickets
benefitRows.offer: Get upto ₹750 discount on movie/non-movie ticket bookings and food & beverages through BookMyShow app/website.|This benefit can be availed twice every month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: CLUB ITC
benefitRows.offer: Book a 3-night stay and pay for only 2 nights at participating ITC Hotels with your Credit Card.|Complimentary night applicable only on room rate; taxes and additional services are payable by the guest.|One complimentary night allowed per booking, valid only for 3-night stays.
